I'm going to try to get a bubbler for my friend for his birthday, and I have a few simple questions.

  1. What is the tobacco name for a bubbler?

  2. Anything I should know before I try buying a bubbler?

I love my bubbler. Two things that I'd suggest keeping it mind are (a) will it stand up securely on it's own? and (b) am I likely to get water in my mouth? A surprising number of them will fail one of the tests.

I do not own one but the Grav Labs version seems to be popular:

http://aqualabtechnologies.com/scientific-glass/grav-labs-glass/grav-labs-standard-basic-bubbler-green.html

You can see how it's designed to stand on it's own, and how the stem is attached high above the water level.

There's a lot of nice, affordable glassware on etsy.com too. That's always a good place to check.
Having reviewed the last comment, include DHGATE in your search, they have a lot of low priced bubblers. YMMV, do read up, but deals can be had.

Try to get some decent glass, if it's too thin then it will obviously break easier. Also, if you are old enough try to buy it in a store, they are usually cooler. If you are like some of us and not old enough then you gotta go online, but the key thing about a bubbler is that it's just like any other pipe except you can put water in it. I recommend smokeday.com the shipping is like $10 and all their products that I have bought from there are awesome quality.
